description:
You are an energy auditor performing a lighting retrofit analysis. The '4StoreyBuilding' project is currently open in eQUEST. Your goal is to update the internal load definitions to reflect a Phase 1 LED retrofit for the Ground Floor and Top Floor.

1. Locate the Space definitions for all Ground Floor zones (names starting with 'G.') and all Top Floor zones (names starting with 'T.').
2. Change the Lighting Power Density (LIGHTING-W/AREA) for these 10 spaces to 0.65 W/ft².
3. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to calculate the energy impact.
4. Save the project.

Note: You must find the spaces in the Building Shell > Internal Loads section. No step-by-step UI navigation is provided.
